pick.name: Substack
pick.what: Newsletter platform with a built-in recommendation network
pick.why: Best discovery for a personal audience from zero
pick.free_limits: Free while unpaid; paid subs 10% + Stripe fees; custom domain $50 one-time (web address only)

alts.name: Kit
alts.why: Best for lead magnets and selling products
alts.free_limits: Free up to 10,000 subs, 1 automation, Kit branding; Creator ~$33-39/mo

alts.name: Buttondown
alts.why: Clean, API-first, custom-domain sending on free tier

candidates.name: Beehiiv / Ghost
candidates.verdict: Beehiiv not verified; Ghost in site slot

decision: Substack wins for growing a personal audience; move to Kit when you want your own sending domain, lead magnets or product sales. Both export subscribers, so lock-in is low.
note: Two audiences, two tools: this is for your personal founder audience. A product's lead and user list lives in the Sales track's newsletter pick.

region_notes.India: Paid Substack subscriptions need Stripe payouts; Stripe India was invite-only (verify).

verify.note: India note about Stripe payouts is a legitimate payments difference; keep. Source is third-party; prefer substack.com support pages.
